nodes.label: Build variant selection
nodes.description: src/utils/config.ts selects OPENSTACK or OVIRT; matching Playwright test/project selected automatically and fixture asserts expected variant.

nodes.label: oVirt UI plugin deployment
nodes.description: Deploy vprotect.json and vprotect-resources to /usr/share/ovirt-engine/ui-plugins/ on Engine; requires oVirt web admin >=4.3.

nodes.label: Mock oVirt plugin API
nodes.description: Development server replaces integration files with mock plugin-api.js exposing configObject and showToast.

nodes.label: oVirt extension installation
nodes.description: Download vprotect-ovirt-plugin.tar.gz, configure vprotect.json vProtectURL ending in /api and credentials, deploy descriptor and vprotect-resources under /usr/share/ovirt-engine/ui-plugins/.

nodes.label: Visual test API write boundary
nodes.description: Every API request is intercepted; unexpected endpoints and HTTP methods fail tests, response arrays include pagination headers, approved read-only POSTs allowed, actual submission endpoints blocked.
nodes.rationale: Screenshot tests validate rendering without changing real backend records or backups.

nodes.label: oVirt extension development
nodes.description: Use Yarn install/build/start; dist contains deployment resources, development server mocks oVirt integration; oVirt web admin version >=4.3 required.

nodes.label: vProtect API configuration
nodes.description: static/vprotect.json config supplies API URL, username and password; URL ends in /api.

nodes.label: Mocked visual test fixtures
nodes.description: visual-test.ts fixes API responses, login, locale, timezone and date; page-data, ovirt-data, vm-details-data, mounted-backup-data, policy-schedule-data and action-dialog-data supply shared responses.

nodes.label: Yarn extension build
nodes.description: yarn install installs modules, yarn build generates dist/vprotect-resources and yarn start launches development server.

nodes.label: Headed and headless rendering
nodes.description: Full Chromium channel shares reference images across headed/headless modes; capture styles normalize native scrollbars and dialog alignment, deterministic viewports and small calendar pixel tolerances.

nodes.label: Reference PNG management
nodes.description: Keep snapshot PNGs versioned and update only for intentional visual changes; review diffs and use same Playwright, browser and OS; mismatches produce actual/expected/diff files and HTML report.
